name: powerview
description: PowerView is a PowerShell tool for Active Directory reconnaissance and enumeration. It provides numerous cmdlets for discovering domain information, users, groups, computers, and more.

commands.name: Get-NetDomain
commands.description: Returns the current domain or information about a specified domain

examples.description: Get information about the current domain

commands.name: Get-NetUser
commands.description: Returns user objects from Active Directory with various filtering options

parameters.name: Identity
parameters.description: Specific user identity to query (username, SID, or DN)

parameters.name: AdminCount
parameters.description: Filter for users with adminCount=1 (privileged accounts)

parameters.name: SPN
parameters.description: Filter for users with Service Principal Names (Kerberoastable)

examples.description: Get all domain users

commands.name: Get-NetGroup
commands.description: Returns group objects from Active Directory

examples.description: Get all domain groups

commands.name: Get-NetGroupMember
commands.description: Returns members of a specific domain group

examples.description: Get members of Domain Admins group

commands.name: Get-NetComputer
commands.description: Returns computer objects from Active Directory

parameters.name: Ping
parameters.description: Only return computers that respond to ping

examples.description: Get all domain computers

commands.name: Get-NetSession
commands.description: Returns active sessions on a target computer

parameters.name: ComputerName
parameters.description: Target computer to query (defaults to localhost)

examples.description: Get sessions on the local computer

commands.name: Get-NetLoggedon
commands.description: Returns logged on users on a target computer

examples.description: Get users logged on to local computer

commands.name: Get-NetShare
commands.description: Returns shared folders on a target computer

examples.description: Get shares on local computer

commands.name: Find-DomainShare
commands.description: Finds accessible shares across the domain

parameters.name: CheckShareAccess
parameters.description: Only return shares the current user can access

examples.description: Find all domain shares

commands.name: Get-DomainGPO
commands.description: Returns Group Policy Objects in the domain

examples.description: Get all domain GPOs

commands.name: Get-DomainOU
commands.description: Returns Organizational Units in the domain

examples.description: Get all domain OUs

commands.name: Find-LocalAdminAccess
commands.description: Finds computers where the current user has local admin access

examples.description: Find all computers where current user is local admin

commands.name: Invoke-UserHunter
commands.description: Finds where specified users are logged in across the domain

examples.description: Hunt for all domain users across computers

commands.name: Invoke-Kerberoast
commands.description: Requests service tickets for Kerberoastable user accounts (users with SPNs) and extracts their password hashes for offline cracking

parameters.name: OutputFormat
parameters.description: Output format for hashes: Hashcat, John (default: Hashcat)

examples.description: Extract Kerberoastable hashes in Hashcat format for all users with SPNs

commands.name: Invoke-ACLScanner
commands.description: Scans for interesting ACL configurations in Active Directory (abusable permissions)

parameters.name: ResolveGUIDs
parameters.description: Resolve GUIDs to their display names

examples.description: Scan for interesting ACLs with resolved GUID names

commands.name: Get-DomainTrust
commands.description: Returns domain trusts for the current or specified domain

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: Specific domain to query for trusts

examples.description: Get all domain trusts for current domain

commands.name: Get-DomainPolicy
commands.description: Returns the domain policy for the current or specified domain

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Source to query (Domain, DC, or All)

examples.description: Get the current domain policy

commands.name: Get-NetFileServer
commands.description: Returns file servers in the domain by querying the domain for all users' HomeDirectory properties

examples.description: Discover file servers in the domain

commands.name: Find-InterestingDomainAcl
commands.description: Finds interesting ACLs on domain objects (similar to Invoke-ACLScanner but with different filtering)

parameters.name: ResolveGUIDs
parameters.description: Resolve GUIDs to their display names

examples.description: Find interesting domain ACLs with resolved GUIDs

commands.name: Add-DomainGroupMember
commands.description: Adds a user/computer to a domain group

parameters.name: Identity
parameters.description: Group identity to add member to

parameters.name: Members
parameters.description: User/computer to add to the group

examples.description: Add a user to Domain Admins group

commands.name: Set-DomainObject
commands.description: Modifies a domain object's attributes

examples.description: Set SPN on a user for targeted Kerberoasting
